data.promptProse: Medea pauses at the fresh-food stall with a wicker basket on one arm, studying two wrapped ingredients seriously beneath the deep hood of her dark-purple robe. Its high inner collar and boots retain the practical market outfit. The medium view connects folded paper and basket to the stall counter, with the street extending behind. Morning light touches wrapper creases and basket weave, while the hood shades her calm blue-eyed concentration.
